newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Chevron signs $305 mln credit deal.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Chevron signs $305 mln credit deal.

text.p: The Saudi Investment Bank said Saudi Chevron Petrochemical (SCP) had signed a $305 million credit facilities deal on Sunday with a group of financial institutions.
The facilities would be used by SCP for the construction and operation of a $650 million aromatics plant at Jubail industrial city, a bank statement said.
The facilities were jointly arranged by Chase Investment Bank, Gulf International Bank, The Industrial Bank of Japan, Saudi Cairo Bank and The Saudi Investment Bank, it added.
SCP is equally owned by Arabian Chevron Petrochemical Company Limited (ACPC), a Bermuda subsidiary of Chevron Corp of the United States and Saudi Industrial Venture Capital Group of Saudi Arabia.
